items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: Oh, sometimes we'd use, uh, Jim Robinson. He used Jim Robinson on some jobs.

ctx.x: Who played trompo with Howard? Or did he have a trompo? We didn't have a trompo.

Oh, sometimes we'd use, uh, Jim Robinson. He used Jim Robinson on some jobs. Mostly we didn't have any trombones. Then after a while, he took Paul Barnes in his band. It was, oh, Treesaxe, yeah. Paul Barnes. I worked with him for quite a long while.
Well, where were you working when, uh, World War II started? Do you remember? World War II when it started?
